title: Balcones Woods Shopping Center Approved
summary:
*   **Major Commercial Zoning Approved:** Council re-zoned land near 11150 Research Blvd. and 5124 Balcones Woods Drive from "Office" to "General Retail."
*   **Paving Way for New Retail:** This zoning change specifically enables the creation of the Balcones Woods Shopping Center, expanding retail options in the area.
*   **Expedited Decision:** The significant land use change was unanimously approved (7-0) in a single meeting, waiving standard multiple readings for quick action.
*   **Private Personnel Discussion:** Following the public vote, the Council entered a closed-door executive session to discuss confidential personnel matters.
